tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully completed same/similar consultancy work involving Pre-Feasibility Study / Feasibility Study / Bathymetric survey / DPR / Engineering Consultancy for Floating Solar Photovoltaic / Solar Power Projects, with a minimum contract value of Rs.27,22,000/-, with single/multiple work orders. The bidder shall furnish copies of Work Order/Letter of Award along with Work Completion/Performance Certificate for similar nature of work issued by the competent authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- copies of Work Order/Letter of Award along with Work Completion/Performance Certificate for similar nature of work issued by the competent authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be an Engineering Consultancy Organisation / Consulting Engineering Firm / Company having experience in carrying out Pre-Feasibility Study / Feasibility Study / Bathymetric survey / Detailed Project Report (DPR) / Engineering Consultancy services for Floating Solar Photovoltaic / Solar Power Projects.

The intending bidder should have achieved a minimum average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.54,44,000/-, in any two of the preceding five financial years and shall enclose the audited Balance Sheets / Turnover Certificates for the preceding five completed financial years, i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26, duly certified/countersigned by a Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
